business_summary.text: Tarsons Products Limited is a manufacturer and supplier of laboratory consumables and medical equipment with a focus on domestic and international markets.

call_points.text: Entire capex program expected to be fully commissioned in H1FY27; no major capex beyond maintenance
Cell culture business to see significant scale-up from FY28 onwards; currently in pilot production
Gross margin pressure to continue in Q1FY27 due to raw material inflation; gradual price hikes being implemented
Focus on deleveraging over next 2-3 years; target debt to not exceed 2x EBITDA

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 2 Per Share

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: An appeal order has been passed reducing the demand of GST from ₹ 68,04,061 along with interest and penalty to ₹ 56,45,599.28 along with interest and penalty at an appropriate rate relevant to Financial Year 2018-19
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed a Writ Petition before the Hon'ble calcutta High Court challenging the order passed by the Appellant Authority on July 1, 2025.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an order from the Joint Commissioner of Customs Adjudication (I), ACC, Mumbai Zone-III under Section 28(4) of the Customs Act, 1962, raising a demand of ₹4,50,835/- for short-paid duty due to an incorrect exemption claim under Notification No. 46/2011-Customs, along with applicable interest. The order also imposes a penalty equivalent to the duty and interest under Section 114A, and a Redemption Fine of ₹7,00,000/- under Section 125(1), as the imported goods are no longer available for confiscation.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Joint Commissioner of Customs Adjudication (I), ACC, Mumbai Zone-II
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed a further appeal before the Appellate Authority against the order.

timeline.summary: Tarsons Products Limited held its Q4FY26 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 25, 2026, reporting 7.7% YoY revenue growth to ₹422.5 Cr and announcing the nearing completion of its capex program with expected benefits from FY27 onwards.

watchlist.response: Gradually increasing prices on a product-by-product basis, but expects some cost sharing with customers in the short term
watchlist.text: Raw material price inflation of 60-70% impacting gross margins and ability to pass on costs to customers

watchlist.response: Monitoring the situation; focusing on domestic market and exploring opportunities in Asia and Latin America
watchlist.text: Export business facing challenges due to geopolitical disruptions and Chinese competition
